\begin{abstract}
We study the weight $\wt(u)$ of elements of $\Zw$.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
Our main result is Theorem~\ref{thm:main}. The weight $\wt(u)$ will be defined later.

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}
Every element of $\Zw$ of weight $0$ is a unit.
\end{theorem}

\section{Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:main}}
By \lemref{lem:bound} and Lemma 2.3, the weight satisfies \eqref{eq:wt-bound}.
Moreover, the previous lemma gives the claim.
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:inner}
Weights are additive on orthogonal parts.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Clearly this follows from Definition~\ref{def:weight} and \cite[Thm.~3]{KMM}.
\end{proof}
This completes the proof, using also Lemma~\ref{lem:missing}.
